svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 960 x 480 mm from 18 mm plywood; sand the edges; mark the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left end (motor end) and the front edge (the brake lever side).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Module bolts: four 6.5 mm holes on a 180 x 100 mm rectangle, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 520 mm from the left end and 240 mm from the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Motor upright feet: four 6.6 mm holes at 122 and 158 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left end, 141.5 and 338.5 mm from the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bar post feet: two 6.6 mm holes 80 mm from the front edge, at 652

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 938 mm from the left end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: E-stop station: fixed with wood screws through its base, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 820 mm from the left end and 390 mm from the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Counterbore the bolt holes from below 13 mm, 3 mm deep, so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: board sits flat on the bench.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the module's rubber pads land on the four 6.5 mm holes.
